pushToTalk.hint: Hold the button or the space bar while you speak.
pushToTalk.hintMouse: Hold the button while you speak.
pushToTalk.toggleHint: Press the button or the space bar; press again when you are done.
pushToTalk.toggleHintMouse: Press the button; press again when you are done.

errors.unsupported: This browser cannot recognise speech: it has no Web Speech API (Firefox, for example).
errors.permission_denied: Microphone access is denied, so nothing was recorded.
errors.no_device: No microphone is available for recording.
errors.no_speech: No speech was recognised in the recording.
errors.browser_only: The server leaves speech recognition to the browser and does not do it itself.
errors.server_not_configured: Speech recognition on the server is not configured.
errors.too_large: The recording is larger than the server accepts.
errors.unsupported_format: The server does not accept the audio format recorded by this browser.
errors.network: The server is unreachable, so the recording was not recognised.
errors.timeout: Speech recognition did not finish in time.
errors.failed: The recording could not be recognised.

errors.unsupported: This browser cannot synthesise speech: it has no Web Speech API (Firefox, for example).
errors.permission_denied: The browser blocked the playback of the reply.
errors.no_device: There is no audio output to play the reply.
errors.browser_only: The server leaves speech synthesis to the browser and does not do it itself.
errors.server_not_configured: Speech synthesis on the server is not configured.
errors.too_large: The reply is too long to pronounce.
errors.unsupported_format: The audio format of the reply is not supported.
errors.network: The server is unreachable, so the reply was not pronounced.
errors.timeout: Speech synthesis did not finish in time.
errors.failed: The reply could not be pronounced.

hints.enableServerStt: Switch speech recognition to the server. {{where}}
hints.enableServerTts: Switch speech synthesis to the server. {{where}}
hints.allowMicrophone: Allow microphone access in the browser address bar and press the button again.
hints.checkMicrophone: Check that a microphone is connected and not taken by another application.
hints.speakAgain: Hold the button and speak a little louder.
hints.browserMode: In this configuration speech is handled by the browser; reload the page to pick up the current server settings.
hints.checkServerConfig: Check the provider settings — API key and model name. {{where}}
hints.typeInstead: You can type your reply instead.
